symptom: `dropdownfilter f (attributes: [Status])` stored attrChoice "auto" and an empty `attr`, with check, exec and mx check all clean; describe printed a bare `dropdownfilter`, and in a gallery's filter bar (no column to inherit from) the filter failed at runtime with "Unable to get filter store" (mendixlabs/mxcli#1519 item 2)
cause: dropdownfilter.def.json mapped `Attributes:` onto `attributes`/`defaultFilter` — the TEXT filter's keys. DataWidgets 3.x DatagridDropdownFilter (3.4.0 in 11.15, same keys in the 11.6 template) has one attribute slot, `attr`, shown only when attrChoice is "linked". Every widgetobj.Builder Set* operation silently skips a key the template does not declare, so the value vanished
file: `sdk/widgets/definitions/dropdownfilter.def.json` (new `attribute` mode on condition `hasAttributes`: attrChoice=linked + attr), `mdl/executor/widget_engine.go` (`refuseUndeclaredMappedKey` via the optional `backend.WidgetPropertyDeclarer`; `Attributes`→`attribute` single-slot resolution + refusal; `selectMode`), `mdl/executor/validate_widgets.go` (`widgetValueMap` ignores inactive modes' constants; MDL-WIDGET47), `mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_parse.go` (reads `attr` back as `Attributes: [A]`)
insight: **A hand-written .def.json can map to a key the widget never had, and nothing notices** — the builder's Set* operations are no-ops for an unknown key. The guard is now in the engine: an AUTHORED value routed to a key the loaded template does not declare fails the statement (constants are exempt — an older widget version lacking a key is not the script's fault; the MCP builder, which cannot answer, does not implement the check). Fixing the mapping alone exposed a second defect: `widgetValueMap` read the constants of EVERY mode, last one winning, so check called the new `attr` hidden under the default mode's attrChoice "auto" and the association mode's baseType "ref" — visible only with a project, because the visibility rules are lifted from the installed .mpk, so a no-project check test passed against the bug. Test the value map directly. Note `modelsdk/widgets/definitions/` holds a second, unused-in-production copy of this def (already attr+linked); `sdk/widgets/definitions/` is the one the registry embeds.
